gripOrHq.title: Team Restructuring
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add one advancement counter to each of up to two installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Project Zurich
gripOrHq.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

gripOrHq.title: Hostile Takeover
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

gripOrHq.title: Project Babylon
gripOrHq.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

heapOrArchives.title: Chicago Branch
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

discardCards.title: HQ Mole
discardCards.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from HQ. Use this ability only when accessing cards from HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

scoreArea.title: Project Venice
scoreArea.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

rig.title: R&D-Protocol Files
rig.rulesText: A: Make a run on R&D, but instead of accessing cards, look at the top five cards of R&D.

rig.title: Psychic Friend
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break code gate subroutine. [2]: +1 strength until end of turn

root.title: Chicago Branch
root.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

root.title: Vapor Ops
root.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.

root.title: Bizarre Encryption Scheme
root.rulesText: Bizarre Encryption Scheme may only be installed in a subsidiary data fort. Runner does not score any agenda (or agendas) that he or she accesses from this fort; return the agenda to the fort instead. Runner scores the agenda at the start of his or her next turn if it is still in the fort.

root.title: Experimental AI
root.rulesText: You may advance Experimental AI before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Experimental AI, trash one program for each advancement counter on it.

accessedCard.title: Experimental AI
accessedCard.rulesText: You may advance Experimental AI before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Experimental AI, trash one program for each advancement counter on it.
